method: Unmodified standard viewer global Terrarium field; bilinear interpolation at pixel centers in the signed building frame. No flattening. 150-meter whole-barrier review grid samples the standard z12 mixed-source DEM; this regional fixture is coarser than local street terrain and does not prove exact gate/threshold levels.
attribution: Mapzen/Terrain Tiles; NASA/USGS and other open elevation sources
limitations: Approximate global viewer terrain; not surveyed urban foundation levels. Vegetation and urban surface returns can affect the field.
